text: Canon round-trips through the store: for every entity this WP ingests, canon -> DB -> canon is byte-identical, and a field that cannot survive the round-trip fails here rather than at migration. The first half of ic's egest-symmetry proposal, accepted 2026-08-15, and homed here rather than at WP-10 because this is where an unreversible FIELD is still cheap to change -- discovering it at WP-10 is ic's own "worst possible moment" argument applied to our schedule. AC-03.6 already holds the hardest single piece (prose bodies byte-identical out of FTS); this generalises it to the whole model. Adding it reopens nothing that AC-03.7 has not already reopened, which is what makes the placement free
